saints.name: Sts. Michael, Gabriel and Raphael
saints.title: Archangels
saints.shortBlurb: The three archangels named in Scripture — the warrior, the messenger, and the healer — honored together on Michaelmas…
biography: Three angels are named in the Scriptures. Michael, “who is like God,” leads the heavenly host against the dragon and is the guardian of the Church. Gabriel, “the strength of God,” announced the Incarnation to Mary and the birth of the Baptist to Zechariah. Raphael, “God heals,” accompanied Tobias on his journey and healed his father's blindness.
Their common feast, long kept as Michaelmas, honors the ministry of the angels in the plan of salvation.
saints.knownFor: The angelic ministry of protection, message, and healing.
